changelog:
byted-mediakit-audio v1.0.0

- Initial release of the audio skill for MediaKit CLI.
- Provides capabilities for audio enhancement and content understanding.
- Supports two main functions: separating voice from background audio (separate-voice) and retrieving detailed audio metadata (probe-audio-metadata).
- Requires mediakit-cli to be installed and available on the system.
summary: 音频处理，涵盖音频处理和增强、内容理解等能力。包含能力：separate-voice, probe-audio-metadata。当用户需要使用 audio 域的 MediaKit CLI 能力时触发。
